mapper.sql: SELECT id FROM question WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND deleted = 0 AND (visibility = 'PUBLIC' OR (visibility = 'PRIVATE' AND owner_user_id = #{userId}))

WITH visible_questions AS (), library AS ( SELECT create_time FROM user_course WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND course_id = #{courseId} ), answer_facts AS ( SELECT 'PRACTICE' AS source, p.id, p.question_id, NULL AS knowledge_point_id, NULL AS knowledge_points_json, p.is_correct, p.create_time AS occurred_time FROM practice_record p JOIN visible_questions q ON q.id = p.question_id CROSS JOIN library l WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.create_time >= l.create_time AND p.is_correct IN (0, 1) AND REGEXP_LIKE(p.user_answer, '[^[:space:]]') UNION ALL SELECT 'PAPER_LEARNING', a.id, a.question_id, NULL, NULL, a.is_correct, a.create_time FROM exam_learning_session s JOIN exam_learning_answer a ON a.session_id = s.id JOIN visible_questions q ON q.id = a.question_id CROSS JOIN library l WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND a.create_time >= l.create_time AND a.is_correct IN (0, 1) AND REGEXP_LIKE(a.user_answer, '[^[:space:]]') UNION ALL SELECT 'EXAM', a.id, a.question_id, NULL, NULL, a.is_correct, COALESCE(a.reviewed_at, a.create_time) FROM exam_record r JOIN exam_answer a ON a.exam_record_id = r.id JOIN visible_questions q ON q.id = a.question_id CROSS JOIN library l WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status != 0 AND a.create_time >= l.create_time AND a.grading_status IN ('AUTO_GRADED', 'REVIEWED') AND a.is_correct IN (0, 1) AND REGEXP_LIKE(a.user_answer, '[^[:space:]]') UNION ALL SELECT 'TUTOR_CHECK', s.id, NULL, s.knowledge_point_id, NULL, s.check_correct, s.check_answered_at FROM tutor_session s CROSS JOIN library l WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.course_id = #{courseId} AND s.check_answered_at >= l.create_time AND s.check_correct IN (0, 1) AND REGEXP_LIKE(s.check_answer, '[^[:space:]]') UNION ALL SELECT 'AI_VARIANT', t.id, t.question_id, NULL, NULL, t.is_correct, t.answered_time FROM ai_variant_training t JOIN visible_questions q ON q.id = t.question_id CROSS JOIN library l WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.status = 'COMPLETED' AND t.answered_time >= l.create_time AND t.is_correct IN (0, 1) AND REGEXP_LIKE(t.user_answer, '[^[:space:]]') UNION ALL SELECT 'STAGE_ASSESSMENT', q.id, q.question_id, NULL, q.knowledge_points_json, q.is_correct, q.answered_time FROM course_stage_assessment a JOIN course_stage_assessment_question q ON q.assessment_id = a.id CROSS JOIN library l WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.course_id = #{courseId} AND a.status = 'COMPLETED' AND q.answered_time >= l.create_time AND q.is_correct IN (0, 1) AND REGEXP_LIKE(q.user_answer, '[^[:space:]]') ), wrong_facts AS ( SELECT w.* FROM wrong_question w JOIN visible_questions q ON q.id = w.question_id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} AND w.deleted = 0 AND w.mastery_level != 2 ), due_facts AS ( SELECT s.* FROM question_review_schedule s JOIN visible_questions q ON q.id = s.question_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.deleted = 0 AND s.next_review_date <= #{today} )
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answer_facts) AS answered_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answer_facts WHERE is_correct = 1) AS correct_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wrong_facts) AS unresolved_wrong_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM due_facts) AS due_review_count, (SELECT MAX(occurred_time) FROM ( SELECT occurred_time FROM answer_facts UNION ALL SELECT e.occurred_time FROM course_learning_event e CROSS JOIN library l WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.course_id = #{courseId} AND e.occurred_time >= l.create_time ) activity) AS last_learning_time
mapper.sql: , current_points AS ( SELECT id, name, sort_order FROM knowledge_point WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND deleted = 0 ), question_points AS ( SELECT rel.question_id, kp.id FROM question_knowledge_point rel JOIN current_points kp ON kp.id = rel.knowledge_point_id ), attributed_answers AS ( SELECT f.source, f.id, p.id AS knowledge_point_id, NULL AS snapshot_name, f.is_correct, f.occurred_time FROM answer_facts f LEFT JOIN question_points p ON p.question_id = f.question_id WHERE f.source NOT IN ('TUTOR_CHECK', 'STAGE_ASSESSMENT') UNION ALL SELECT source, id, knowledge_point_id, NULL, is_correct, occurred_time FROM answer_facts WHERE source = 'TUTOR_CHECK' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT f.source, f.id, IF(j.id > 0, j.id, NULL), j.name, f.is_correct, f.occurred_time FROM answer_facts f LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE( CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(f.knowledge_points_json) THEN CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(f.knowledge_points_json) = 'ARRAY' THEN f.knowledge_points_json ELSE '[]' END ELSE '[]' END, '$[*]' COLUMNS (id BIGINT PATH '$.id' NULL ON ERROR, name VARCHAR(100) PATH '$.name' NULL ON ERROR) ) j ON TRUE WHERE f.source = 'STAGE_ASSESSMENT' ), snapshot_names AS ( SELECT knowledge_point_id, snapshot_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY knowledge_point_id ORDER BY occurred_time DESC, id DESC, snapshot_name DESC) AS name_order FROM attributed_answers WHERE snapshot_name IS NOT NULL ), answer_counts AS ( SELECT knowledge_point_id, COUNT(DISTINCT source, id) AS answered_count, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(is_correct = 1, source, NULL), IF(is_correct = 1, id, NULL)) AS correct_count FROM attributed_answers GROUP BY knowledge_point_id ), wrong_counts AS ( SELECT p.id AS knowledge_point_id, COUNT(DISTINCT w.question_id) AS unresolved_wrong_count FROM wrong_facts w LEFT JOIN question_points p ON p.question_id = w.question_id GROUP BY p.id ), due_counts AS ( SELECT p.id AS knowledge_point_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.question_id) AS due_review_count FROM due_facts d LEFT JOIN question_points p ON p.question_id = d.question_id GROUP BY p.id ), point_ids AS ( SELECT id FROM current_points UNION SELECT knowledge_point_id FROM answer_counts UNION SELECT knowledge_point_id FROM wrong_counts UNION SELECT knowledge_point_id FROM due_counts )
mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS knowledge_point_id, CASE WHEN p.id IS NULL THEN '未关联知识点' ELSE COALESCE(k.name, n.snapshot_name, CONCAT('知识点 #', p.id)) END AS knowledge_point_name, k.id IS NOT NULL AS available, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tutor_content t WHERE t.knowledge_point_id = k.id AND t.review_status = 'REVIEWED') AS tutor_available, COALESCE(a.answered_count, 0) AS answered_count, COALESCE(a.correct_count, 0) AS correct_count, COALESCE(w.unresolved_wrong_count, 0) AS unresolved_wrong_count, COALESCE(d.due_review_count, 0) AS due_review_count FROM point_ids p LEFT JOIN current_points k ON k.id = p.id LEFT JOIN snapshot_names n ON n.knowledge_point_id = p.id AND n.name_order = 1 LEFT JOIN answer_counts a ON a.knowledge_point_id <=> p.id LEFT JOIN wrong_counts w ON w.knowledge_point_id <=> p.id LEFT JOIN due_counts d ON d.knowledge_point_id <=> p.id ORDER BY k.id IS NULL, k.sort_order, p.id IS NULL, p.id LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT s.question_id FROM question_review_schedule s JOIN () q ON q.id = s.question_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.deleted = 0 AND s.next_review_date <= #{today} ORDER BY s.next_review_date, s.id LIMIT 1
SELECT w.question_id FROM wrong_question w JOIN () q ON q.id = w.question_id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} AND w.deleted = 0 AND w.mastery_level != 2 ORDER BY w.wrong_count DESC, w.id LIMIT 1

SELECT t.knowledge_point_id, t.title, CASE WHEN MAX(s.check_correct) = 1 THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN COUNT(s.id) > 0 THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' ELSE 'NOT_STARTED' END AS status FROM knowledge_point k JOIN tutor_content t ON t.knowledge_point_id = k.id AND t.review_status = 'REVIEWED' LEFT JOIN tutor_session s ON s.tutor_content_id = t.id AND s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.course_id = #{courseId} WHERE k.course_id = #{courseId} AND k.deleted = 0 GROUP BY k.id, k.sort_order, t.id, t.knowledge_point_id, t.title ORDER BY k.sort_order, k.id, t.id
